info.title: Legacy 22 API
info.description: The HTTP API behind the Legacy 22 Kanban application. Every error is a problem document (RFC 7807) carrying a traceId. A session is two httpOnly cookies set by POST /auth/login and renewed on any request that still carries the refresh cookie.

201.description: Account created; a confirmation e-mail is sent. Also answered for an address already registered, so the form reveals nothing.

post.summary: Sign in and receive the session cookies

200.description: Signed in; Set-Cookie carries the session

delete.summary: Delete the account and its personal data

post.summary: Ask for a password reset link

202.description: Accepted, whether or not the address has an account

post.summary: Set a new password from a reset link

204.description: Password changed; every session of the account is ended

post.summary: Sign out and clear the session cookies

202.description: A confirmation link is sent to the new address

get.summary: Export every personal data of the account

200.description: The export, as a JSON document to download

get.summary: The projects of the caller, a page at a time

post.summary: Create a project owned by the caller

delete.summary: Delete a project the caller owns

get.summary: Who is in a project, and with which role

delete.summary: Remove a member; their tasks stay in the project

get.summary: What needs attention across the caller's projects

post.summary: Invite a person into a project by their address; the owner only

201.description: Invited (201), or already a member or already invited (200): nothing is created twice

get.summary: The invitations waiting for the caller's answer

post.summary: Accept an invitation; the caller joins the project as a member

get.summary: The tasks of a project, searched, filtered and paged

put.summary: Change the name, priority, due date or assignees of a task

patch.summary: Move a task to another Kanban column
Swap a task with its neighbour in its column

post.summary: Run one delivery pass of the event outbox

200.description: What the pass published, consumed and failed

post.summary: Run one pass of the retention purge

200.description: Rows deleted per treatment; no personal data

get.summary: The current gauges as one JSON row, for a live dashboard

200.description: Gauge name to value; no personal data

get.summary: Metrics in the Prometheus text format

Error400.description: The request is malformed or a value is invalid

Error403.description: Refused for this caller or this resource

Error404.description: Not found, or not visible to the caller

Error409.description: Changed by another request, or a rule of the resource forbids it

Error429.description: Too many attempts; Retry-After gives the seconds to wait

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before asking again

Error500.description: A failure on our side; quote the traceId

Error503.description: A dependency is throttled, too slow or unreachable; Retry-After gives the seconds to wait

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before asking again
